gaps.title: Lab drops an open-weights coding agent model that runs on a single GPU
gaps.summary: A new open-weights model tuned for agentic coding is posting strong benchmark numbers and people are running it locally on one consumer GPU. Devs on X are sharing side-by-side runs against hosted models.

top_posts.text: ran it on my 4090 for an hour of real repo work. not hosted-model good, but way closer than I expected
the license is the real story here, commercial use allowed

gaps.title: Major AI lab opens its browser-agent API to all developers
gaps.summary: The browser-agent API that was waitlist-only is now generally available, with lower pricing and a new session replay feature. Builders are posting first automations.

top_posts.text: session replay is the killer feature. you can finally see where the agent got lost

gaps.title: New platform rules for AI voice clones in creator videos
gaps.summary: A big video platform announced disclosure labels and consent checks for AI voice clones, rolling out next month. Creators are debating what counts as a clone.

top_posts.text: if you use AI voiceover on your channel read this before next month
